environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB access logs enabled to S3 but no active monitoring. No WAF WebACL attached to the ALB. Application runs as systemd service under non-root user 'appuser'. SQLite database stored at /var/lib/app/users.db with filesystem permissions 0644.
